meta.name: Merrick Link toll road PPP (Case T)
meta.status_note: Assumptions only; outputs computed by the reference model and recorded in the figure ledger.

currency.name: Ardmore dollar
currency.note: USD equivalents for cross-case comparison only; the model runs in ARD

periodicity.construction: quarterly, first stub 2015-05-27 to 2015-06-30, then calendar quarters to 2019-03-31 (base) / 2019-06-30 (actual, opening 2019-05-06)
periodicity.operations: semiannual, periods ending 30 June and 31 December
periodicity.day_count: ACT/365 for ARD loans and bonds coupons 30/360

meta.units_convention: _ard_m = ARD millions; _k_per_day = thousand vehicle trips per day; _pct percent; _x ratio; prices labelled _2014 or _2015 are base-date prices before indexation

jurisdiction.country: Commonwealth of Ardmore (federal, common law, OECD member)
jurisdiction.contracting_authority: Brannock Roads and Transport Authority (BRTA), with Partnerships Brannock as procuring agency within Brannock Treasury
jurisdiction.federal_lender: National Infrastructure Lending Office (NILO), Commonwealth Infrastructure Credit Program
jurisdiction.insolvency_regime: Companies Act (Ardmore) Part 9 restructuring plan with cross-class cram-down, modeled on common-law practice

macro.abbr_note: ABBR = Ardmore Bank Bill Rate (fictional 6-month bank bill benchmark)

road.tolling: free-flow electronic, distance-based, transponder and video
road.corridor: Port Ellery northern ring road to Holloway Junction freight hub via the Coldwater Plains growth area
road.competing_free_route: State Route 14, 47.6 km, signalized through four town centers

computed_by_model: IDC on bank, bonds (net of escrow earnings) and contribution bridge
capex_ard_m.other_costs_timing: development costs 100% at close; SPV costs, certifier and advisors flat over construction; insurance 80% at close and 20% at 2017Q2; contingency drawn pro rata with D&C

dc_terms.contractor: Holbrook-Daneshill Joint Venture (Holbrook Civil 60%, Daneshill Construction 40%), joint and several

bridge.name: Contribution Bridge Facility
bridge.draw: pro rata with senior bank facility in the last 6 construction quarters

tolls.escalation_rule_original: each 1 July: max(CPI, 3.0%) to 2030-06-30, CPI thereafter; tolls rounded to ARD 0.0001/km
tolls.maximum_toll_regime: Concession sets maximum tolls; concessionaire may discount

traffic_k_trips_per_day.definition: average daily vehicle trips on the road; revenue = trips x 365 (or days in period) x average trip length x car toll per km x weighted class multiplier

opex_ard_m_2015_prices.handback_reserve: funded over the last 5 years of the concession to the IE-certified handback works estimate

tax.concession_asset_amortization: straight line from opening over remaining concession term (intangible asset model)
tax.loss_carryforward: indefinite, subject to continuity of ownership or same business test (same business test satisfied in 2023)
tax.debt_forgiveness_rule: forgiven commercial debt reduces carried-forward losses first, then the tax cost base of the concession asset

bank_mini_perm.lenders: Castellan Bank, Penhallow Bank, Kaito Pacific Bank, Sterrenberg Bank NV
bank_mini_perm.base_case_refinancing_assumption: refinanced at maturity on the same sculpted profile at ABBR + 2.25% with 1.25% fees
bank_mini_perm.hedging: 100% of bank facility notional and assumed refinancing to 2035-06-30, fixed 3.48%

bonds.name: Brannock Infrastructure Revenue Bonds, Series 2015 (issuer BIFA, on-lent to the concessionaire)
bonds.funding: fully funded at close; proceeds in escrow earning 2.10% until used
bonds.amortization: sculpted 2021-06-30 to 2048-12-31 pro rata with bank profile
bonds.tax_status: Qualified Infrastructure Bond: interest exempt from Commonwealth income tax for holders

nilo_loan.sizing: remainder after senior and 22.0% equity; check combined senior+NILO min DSCR >= 1.25x banking and <= 33% eligible costs
nilo_loan.draw: pro rata with senior after equity is fully contributed
nilo_loan.interest: capitalized until 2024-03-31 (5 years after scheduled opening)
nilo_loan.ranking: subordinated in payment; springing lien to pari passu with senior on a bankruptcy or insolvency event

covenants.distributions: subject to lock-up, DSRA full, no default

ppp_shadow_bid.state_contribution_pv_of_410.0_paid_2019: computed by model at 6.85% from 2019-03-31 to 2012-12-31

termination_regime.authority_default_or_voluntary: senior debt outstanding including breakage + NILO outstanding + equity compensation = NPV of base-case distributions to equity at the base-case equity IRR (11.4%)
termination_regime.concessionaire_default: retendering procedure: compensation = adjusted highest compliant tender price less retendering costs; if no liquid market, estimated fair value; no debt floor
termination_regime.relief_event_and_fm: COVID-19 treated as a Relief Event (relief from termination and KPI deductions, no compensation). Prolonged uninsurable FM > 270 days: senior debt + NILO + equity contributed less distributions
termination_regime.lender_step_in: 90 days, extendable to 180, under the Financiers' Direct Deed

events.standstill_terms: interest paid as cash allows, principal deferred, 100% cash sweep, no enforcement; bank maturity extended to 2023-12-31 by A&E signed 2022-05-20 with fee 0.50% and margin 3.25%

restructuring.senior_claims_basis: bank principal + bond principal + accrued unpaid interest at 2023-12-31; swap terminated at MTM (positive to concessionaire) and set off

restructured_senior_notes.amortization: sculpted semiannual 2024-06-30 to 2052-12-31 to min DSCR 1.30x on Ridgeway 2023 case

restructuring.original_equity: shares cancelled, shareholder loans including 2021 support written off; Wexcombe and Corvus receive warrants over 3% of new equity, exercisable if senior notes are repaid in full
restructuring.state_revenue_share: 30% of annual toll revenue above ARD 260.0m (2023 prices, CPI-indexed)

scenarios.actual_history: actual traffic and events through 2026H1, Ridgeway 2023 case afterwards
